data_testid_convention: Use kebab-case, role-based attributes for all interactive and key elements (e.g., 'hero-cta-button', 'waitlist-email-input', 'waitlist-submit-button', 'nav-link-features').
instructions_to_main_agent: Enforce dark mode completely by using `bg-[#0A0A0A]` on the body or main wrapper.
Build the layout using pure HTML/Tailwind (.js, not .tsx).
The Hero section must have the prominent 'Explore the Future of Clean Air' CTA.
Use a Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for the key features: App connectivity, Air quality tracking, Voice control, Whisper-silent design.
Create a Specs section using the minimalist glass cards and high-contrast typography.
Include a Pricing teaser that emphasizes 'Accessible Luxury'.
Build a Waitlist / email capture form at the bottom with proper focus states.
Every interactive element MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
